recentItems.title: OZON hub for HALF A MILLION PACKAGES ON FIRE! "FP-7" BALLISTIC missile goes HUNTING!
recentItems.description:
Ukrainian drones destroyed the OZON logistics hub in Saratov with a capacity of 500,000 packages per day, paralyzing the enemy's rear supply lines.
Meanwhile, Ukraine's new "FP-7" ballistic missile has entered final military trials – its combat deployment is expected in just a few weeks!
At the same time, the Kremlin's budget took a devastating blow: according to Ukrainian data, three out of five tankers recently attacked by the US military belonged to Russia's "shadow fleet."

recentItems.title: Time to gather stones. Ukrainians on the battlefields of World War II | Official trailer
recentItems.description:
Millions of Ukrainians fought for the freedom of the world from Nazism on the fiercest battlefields of the Second World War — in the ranks of different armies, on every continent and in the European resistance movement.

Yet for decades, the memory of their heroic deeds remained trapped in the Soviet-Russian imperial myth. Even today, as Russia wages a brutal war aimed at destroying Ukraine, the names of Ukrainian heroes are still often labelled as “Russian” on European memorials, in books and on mass graves.

Who really saved the world from Nazism? This documentary project dismantles the Kremlin’s multilayered propaganda and restores to Europe the true faces of its liberators.

The film tells the stories of Ukrainians who fought heroically in Italian and French partisan units, served in the French Foreign Legion and whose glory was cynically appropriated by Moscow: Vasyl Poryk, Heorhii Lipnytskyi, Mykola Buianov, Oleksandr Nakorchеmnyi and Petro Bilobran.

Using unique declassified archival files, family heirlooms, museum collections and extensive filming in Italy, France and Ukraine, the filmmakers restore historical justice and affirm the Ukrainian people’s inalienable right to their own memory and truthful history.

Time to Gather Stones is a powerful restoration of Ukrainian agency and the Ukrainian voice within Europe’s broader history of victory.

Produced by: the State Enterprise “Multimedia Platform for Foreign Broadcasting of Ukraine.”

recentItems.title: 1.5 MILLION IN GRAVE: why Russia does not stop. New drone era and Ukrainian experience saves Canada
recentItems.description:
One and a half million invaders killed or maimed — that is the unprecedented price of the Kremlin’s imperial ambitions. Yet the aggressor continues to ruthlessly throw wave after wave of troops into the front line.

What should the civilised world do when the enemy appears to have an “endless” supply of cheap cannon fodder? The answer is obvious and uncompromising: complete technological dominance, mass drone production and the robotisation of the front line.

In today’s episode, we examine the deepening cooperation between Kyiv and Ottawa. Canada — one of Ukraine’s most committed strategic allies — clearly understands the modern nature of warfare and is actively adopting the invaluable combat experience of Ukrainian defenders.

How will joint defence projects, UAV innovations and forward-looking security agreements help offset the dictatorship’s numerical advantage? We take an in-depth look, without sugar-coating the facts.

recentItems.title: A 100 YEAR ALLIANCE CANADA IS GIVING UKRAINE A THIRD OF ITS DRONES AND MILLIONS FOR AIR DEFENCE!
recentItems.description:
Ukraine and Canada have signed a 100-year Partnership Declaration. Ottawa is providing 430 million Canadian dollars to support gas purchases, 350 million Canadian dollars for air-defence missiles, will send Ukraine one-third of its future drone production, and is joining the FREYJA anti-ballistic missile program.

At the same time, Russia is escalating the situation in the southwest. Russian drones attacked four border-crossing points, killing two people in Starokozache. One UAV crossed Moldova and entered Romania, prompting NATO F-18 fighter jets to take to the skies. Meanwhile, Moldova’s security services are reporting the mass recruitment of FSB agents to work against Ukraine.
